description: Angular component for a multi-image input with drag-and-drop, file upload, and preview features, used within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: MultipleImageInputComponent
classes.description: Angular component for handling multiple image uploads with drag-and-drop, preview, and size validation.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Initializes event subscriptions for file uploads and sets up the component after view initialization.

methods.name: readImageUrl
methods.description: Reads a file and converts it to a data URL, returning safe URL for Angular sanitization.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from event subscriptions to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form control.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's value from external sources.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the form model with current image URLs.

methods.name: clearImage
methods.description: Removes an image at a specified index.

methods.name: imageDragStart
methods.description: Handles the start of an image drag operation.

methods.name: imageDragEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of an image drag operation.

methods.name: imageDrop
methods.description: Handles dropping an image to reorder.
